programme.title: Live: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly "1 Big Thing" commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in "Bad Beats." The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: NFL GameDay Live

programme.title: Quererte así [NEW]
programme.desc: Una historia de amor que nace en medio de la avaricia de una familia, los destinos de Paulina y Rafael se cruzan y ellos caen víctimas de un amor profundo, el cual, está condenado al infortunio porque ellos provienen de dos clases sociales totalmente distintas, ella proviene de una prominente familia que posee uno de los consorcios hoteleros más grandes del país y por el contrario, él es un hombre humilde que no tiene nada que ofrecer a nivel monetario. Su amor puro y verdadero, deberá enfrentar a la familia de Paulina que está en contra y que desea que ella se case con un hombre afluente. Su destino es luchar por su amor y defender su felicidad por "Quererte Así".

programme.title: Cosas de la vida
programme.desc: Rocío Sanchez Azuara, la afamada y bella presentadora conduce "Cosas de la Vida", un programa de charla producido por TV Azteca, que trata temas y problemas que se presentan en la vida diaria de personas comunes. Cada capítulo de una hora relata historias reales y dramáticas, en donde sus protagonistas exponen sus casos conmovedores que llegan a tocar los corazones del público, incluyendo al de la conductora del programa y gracias a la ayuda de un equipo experto de profesionales y de la audiencia que está presente en el estudio, se tratan de resolver estos conflictos personales o familiares que los invitados están enfrentado.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: La loba
programme.desc: Ivonne Montero protagoniza a Ángeles Fernández, una mujer hermosa, tenaz e inteligente, quien sufre creyendo que su madre la abandonó, pero ella desconoce los hechos reales de su ausencia, ya que su madre estuvo en la cárcel; la joven se roba el corazón de Emilio Alcázar (Mauricio Islas), un hombre de negocios adinerado que había prometido no volverse a enamorar. La Loba, es una adaptación escrita por Bethel Flores, la cual es una versión nueva de la telenovela argentina, Los Ángeles No Lloran.

programme.title: SportsCenter (Live)
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Live)
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly "1 Big Thing" commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in "Bad Beats." The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: College Football : Wisconsin at Maryland ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The Badgers (6-3, 4-2 Big Ten) try to exact revenge from the Terrapins (3-6, 1-5). Maryland won for the first time in five tries against Wisconsin, 27-10 in 2025. Maryland snapped a six-game slide with a 34-29 triumph over Purdue last week.

programme.title: College Football : Michigan at Oregon ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The Michigan Wolverines (5-4) visit the No. 16 Oregon Ducks (6-3) for a Big Ten matchup at Autzen Stadium. Michigan fell to Michigan State 15-6 and relies on Bryce Underwood, while Oregon seek to make it three straight after beating Ohio State 41-28.

programme.title: College Football : Minnesota at Penn State ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The Penn State Nittany Lions (5-4, 2-4 Big Ten) host the Minnesota Golden Gophers (5-4, 3-3 Big Ten) at Beaver Stadium in University Park. Drake Lindsey leads Minnesota with 11 touchdowns, while Rocco Becht leads Penn State with 15 touchdowns.

programme.title: College Football : Wyoming at Texas-El Paso ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The UTEP Miners (1-8, 0-5 Mountain West) host the Wyoming Cowboys (6-3, 5-1 Mountain West) at the Sun Bowl in El Paso. Wyoming aims for a five-game win streak behind Tyler Hughes, while UTEP hopes to break a seven-game losing streak.

programme.title: College Football : Northwestern at Ohio State
programme.desc: The No. 20 Ohio State Buckeyes (6-3, 4-2 Big Ten) host the Northwestern Wildcats (6-3, 3-3 Big Ten) at Ohio Stadium. Both teams aim to break a two-game skid. Northwestern relies on Aidan Chiles, while Ohio State looks to Julian Sayin.

programme.title: College Football : Utah at Arizona
programme.desc: The No. 2 Utes (9-0, 6-0 Big 12) seek their first 10-0 start since 2008 as they visit the No. 23 Wildcats (7-2, 4-2). Utah comes off a 28-20 triumph over rival BYU. Arizona has won seven straight at home following a 29-28 victory over TCU last week.

programme.desc: The Illinois Fighting Illini (6-3) travel to Pasadena to take on the undefeated No. 8 UCLA Bruins (9-0) at the historic Rose Bowl. Illinois defeated Nebraska, 24-13, with three touchdowns by Katin Houser, while UCLA won against Minnesota, 34-20.

programme.title: NBA: Pistons at Heatᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The visiting Detroit Pistons, leading this NBA series 1-0, visit Kaseya Center to face Miami Heat (5-6). The 7-3 Pistons, top in blocks and steals, meet the Heat's second-ranked assists, driven by Antetokounmpo's 27.7 points and 12.6 rebounds; Cunningham's 22.3 points and 7.6 assists lead. Despite home court, the Pistons are favorites, their form and series lead ominous.

programme.title: NBA: Knicks at Raptorsᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: Kicking off a fierce new series at Scotiabank Arena, the visiting New York Knicks and Toronto Raptors reignite a heated NBA rivalry. New York carries a superior 6-5 record against the Raptors' 5-7 mark, entering as the clear favorites despite road inconsistencies. New York relies on the powerhouse pairing of J. Brunson's prolific 26.6 points and K. Towns' monstrous 13.7 rebounds and league-leading 12 double-doubles, while former Knick S. Barnes strikes back for Toronto with 23.5 points and a league-best 2.2 thefts per game. The Raptors lead the league in offensive rebounds and boast elite assist numbers, yet their prolific foul habit remains a critical flaw. This early-season clash is a massive test of the teams' shifting trajectories.
